correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently reconstructed the four pair-vs-cycle overlap types under row-wise hypergeometric sampling without replacement: outside/outside zero; exactly one shared vertex contributes ℓ(n−ℓ)p^ℓ(q−p²); nonconsecutive inside pair contributes ℓ(ℓ−3)p^(ℓ−2)(q²−p⁴)/2; adjacent inside contributes ℓ(p^(ℓ−1)q−p^(ℓ+2)). Here p=k/(n−1), q=k(k−1)/((n−1)(n−2)), distinct rows independent. Summing over (n)_ℓ/ℓ oriented cyclic words yields exact Cov(C2,Cℓ)=−(n)_ℓ k^ℓ(n−k−1)²(2n−ℓ−1)/[2(n−1)^(ℓ+2)(n−2)²]. Fresh rational arithmetic verified all 440 n,k,ℓ strata for 3≤n≤12, 1≤k<n, 3≤ℓ≤n. Positivity of 2n−ℓ−1 proves strictly negative when k≤n−2 and zero for k=n−1. ER shared-arc argument gives (n)_ℓ p^(ℓ+1)(1−p)>0. Fixed-k and dense limits follow algebraically; no asymptotic claim for variable ℓ.
